scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/web dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/web build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine test && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/web test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.dev:emulators: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/web dev --mode emulator
scripts.emulators: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-gem-arena --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:emulators: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gem-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "node apps/web/scripts/verify-emulators.mjs"
scripts.test:views: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gem-arena --only auth,firestore "node apps/web/scripts/verify-game-views.mjs"
scripts.test:actions: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gem-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "node apps/web/scripts/verify-submit-action.mjs"
scripts.test:live-board: corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/engine build && corepack pnpm --filter @gem-arena/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gem-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "node apps/web/scripts/verify-live-board.mjs"
